name: drupal/commerce_domains
description: Sell domain names with Drupal Commerce: domain product fields, registrars and marketplace providers.

suggest.drupal/commerce_escrow: To let buyers negotiate offers on Escrow.com (Commerce Domains Offers via Escrow.com).
suggest.drupal/commerce_pricelist: To give marketplaces their own prices, or prices in other currencies.
suggest.drupal/commerce_exchanger: To convert prices into the currencies marketplaces list in.
suggest.drupal/key: To pick, on each provider, keys that hold its API credentials (from environment variables or files) instead of setting them in settings.php.
suggest.drush/drush: To review and push marketplace syncs with drush commerce-domains:marketplace-sync.
